reviewScope.summary: Independent read-only review of the Q01-F-CORE implementation diff and exported programme content.
evidence: Reviewed GitHub commit fbfe4173548d5f82e2e935e89b21aecb0ef63f57 against base 2e6e37c30bb3b62de3269ecd15c56ff8d6ffb38d.
Compared full before/after M01, M02 and programme index JSON structures.
M01 changes only the shared source SHA. M02 changes the intended teaching, explanation and feedback fields.
Programme index changes source identity, O06 time estimate and four exercise content hashes only.
Implementer reports 60 existing tests, two targeted integration probes, Python checks and production build passing. Not independently rerun.

adversarialFindings.description: The earlier nine-block L07 candidate displaced ordinal learner bookmarks.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The final candidate restores ten L07 blocks and the original mission ranges. Bookmark compatibility was tested with four synthetic fixtures.

adversarialFindings.description: Four changed exercise hashes invalidate earlier answers as evidence of current mastery.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted existing version-bound evidence policy. Stored history and earned XP remain preserved; new current-version attempts are supported.

adversarialFindings.description: The M01 asset receives a new hash-addressed filename although its learning content is unchanged.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Direct JSON comparison confirms only its shared source SHA changed; this is a derived export consequence.

retrospective.summary: The reviewed Q01 content changes are bounded and technically coherent. No independent implementation blocker found. Hosted release certification and production verification remain mandatory.
